Explore Training

Find Your
Discipline.

Maddog Performance Institute is the KZN North Coast's only world-champion led training facility — home to MMA, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Kickboxing, Boxing, Powerlifting and Personal Training, all under one roof, all coached by certified, competition-proven specialists. Whether you're stepping onto a mat for the first time, bringing your kids for their first class, chasing a competitive title, or simply want the most effective training system in Ballito — pick a discipline below and see exactly what a class looks like, who coaches it, and what it costs. Your first class is always free.
